title: Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
abstract: arXiv:2611.19680v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning can make automated red-teaming more successful while narrowing the attacks it produces. Co-training an attacker and a defender with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been reported to reduce attacker diversity. This experiment reproduces attack diversity reduction using three runs with a Qwen2.5-14B attacker and a Phi-4-mini defender trained by direct preference optimization (DPO). The attacker receives a success-only reward and uses a length-unbiased loss, bounded updates, warm-up and ratio clipping. The attacker is evaluated on 26 AdvBench behaviors. Training ended after 12 rounds, following a decision based on development checkpoints, so the reported intervals are nominal. Attack Diversity Retention (ADR) compares the within-behavior of the trained attacker spread with the untrained attacker. translated_title: 自适应大语言模型红队测试中攻击者多样性的降低
translated_abstract: 强化学习可以在提高自动化红队测试成功率的同时缩小其产生的攻击范围。已有报道称，使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）对攻击者和防御者进行协同训练会降低攻击者的多样性。本实验通过三次运行复现了攻击多样性降低的现象，其中攻击者采用Qwen2.5-14B模型，防御者采用通过直接偏好优化（DPO）训练的Phi-4-mini模型。攻击者仅接收基于成功的奖励，并使用长度无偏损失、有界更新、预热和比率裁剪。攻击者在26个AdvBench行为上进行评估。基于开发检查点的决策，训练在12轮后结束，因此所报告的区间为名义区间。攻击多样性保留率（ADR）通过比较训练后攻击者与未训练攻击者在单个行为内的攻击分布广度来衡量多样性变化。为认定攻击多样性已被降低，评判标准要求ADR低于某一阈值。
tldr: 该论文使用Qwen2.5-14B攻击者与DPO训练的Phi-4-mini防御者进行GRPO协同训练实验，复现了自适应LLM红队测试中攻击者多样性降低的现象，并提出了攻击多样性保留率（ADR）作为衡量指标。
en_tdlr: This paper reproduces attacker diversity reduction in adaptive LLM red teaming through GRPO co-training of a Qwen2.5-14B attacker and a DPO-trained Phi-4-mini defender, introducing Attack Diversity Retention (ADR) as the evaluation metric.
